in_sanskrit.name: Dancer
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है One who moves gracefully
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Dancer एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Nritya', meaning 'dance' or 'movement'. In Hindu mythology, dancers are believed to bring harmony and joy to the world, as they embody the divine energy of Shiva and Parvati.
